title: A designed generalist binding protein evolves into a highly active designed enzyme
summary: Crystallographic fragment screening found weak binders of a designed protein, which were then evolved into a catalyst that the authors describe as the most active designed enzyme to date. AI models were used in the redesign step, while the crystal structures and enzyme assays were experimental. Kinetic values and design counts were not checked in the primary paper, so the record claim rests on press statements.
ai_technology: AI-guided protein redesign (specific models not verified)
organization: University of California, San Francisco (Fraser and DeGrado groups)
